entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return a helmet. I have the order number if you need it.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Just to be sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just the wrong color. I thought it would be a different shade. The box is still unopened. Is this something I can return or not? I don't have a lot of time.
I understand completely. Yes, let me just pull up your account. I see the order here, delivered about 58 days ago. One moment while I check the policy for you.

Okay, I've confirmed it. Because this is a standard item, you're well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process this for you. Your safety on the road is paramount, and we want you to be confident in your gear, including the color.
Great. So you'll send a label?

Yes. I have just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to the address on file. Just print it, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
